content: If the API SomeIpTp_RxIndication() is called and a session is currently active, the SOME/IP TP module shall check if the TP-Flag of the Message Type is set to '1'. If the TP-Flag is not set to '1', • The current assembly process shall be interrupted as defined by SWS_SomeIp Tp_00054. • The API Det_ReportRuntimeError() shall be called with the runtime error code SOMEIPTP_E_MESSAGE_TYPE.
